command.name: pg-router
command.provenance: pg-router --help ('pg-router routes typed events from configured sources through a durable queue'), this host 2026-10-26 (help hash identical to the source build at this commit)

provenance.source: pg-router --help, first line: "usage: pg-router [--version | --help] [run ... | status [--json] ...]" and "pg-router routes typed events from configured sources through a durable queue to configured handler roles"

stdin.source: pg-router --help: no modeled subcommand reads stdin (ingest-event and self-status, the callbacks that do, are not modeled)

stdout.source: pg-router --help: operator subcommands print text, or JSON with --json; status and level list report the running core's state (content)

unknownFlag.source: pg-router --help: top level takes only [--version | --help]; --socket, --token and the run-scoped selectors belong to subcommands this spec does not model

citation.source: pg-router --help usage line: "pg-router [--version | --help] ..." and "help  print this help and exit"
pg-router --help usage line: "pg-router [--version | --help] ..." and "version  print the version and exit"
pg-router --help: `-h` is accepted as the short form of --help by the usage line's [--version | --help] group
pg-router --help: the dispatch verbs are the subcommands below; the top level takes no operand of its own (bare "pg-router" prints usage and exits non-zero)

stdout.source: pg-router --help: "config --print-defaults  print the built-in default config.toml"; "config --show [--json]  print the resolved config path, role set, and worker dispatch scalars"; "config check ... printed, one per line" (content)

unknownFlag.source: pg-router --help lists config --print-defaults, --show, --json (valid only with --show) and the word check; any other flag is unmodeled and insufficient

citation.source: pg-router --help: "config --print-defaults  print the built-in default config.toml (copy-paste starting point)"
pg-router --help: "config --show [--json]  print the resolved config path, role set, and worker dispatch scalars"

pg-router --help: "config check  run the startup config checks on demand: every problem loading the config ... is printed ... Exit 0 and one config ok line when there is none" (the word check; it stats handler files, it runs none)

explain.name: explain
explain.provenance: pg-router --help, explain <role>: the current admission decision of one role, read from the RUNNING core

provenance.source: pg-router --help: "explain <role> [--socket <path>] [--token <tok>]  say whether the role is paused by levels RIGHT NOW and why"

stdin.source: pg-router --help: explain takes the role as an argument and reads no stdin

stdout.source: pg-router --help: explain prints the paused-role line naming each failing requirement, or reports the role as not paused (content)

unknownFlag.source: pg-router --help: explain lists only [--socket <path>] [--token <tok>] beyond <role>; any other flag is unmodeled and insufficient

citation.source: pg-router --help: "explain <role> [--socket <path>] [--token <tok>]"; the role is a name, not a path ("An unknown role exits 1 with \"unknown role <name>\"")

provenance.source: pg-router --help usage line: "level (list [--json] | set <resource> <LEVEL> ... | clear ... | refresh ...)"
